name: twoai-site

scripts.prebuild: node scripts/audit-check.mjs && node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && node scripts/fit-covers.mjs && node scripts/fetch-content.mjs
scripts.postbuild: pagefind --site dist && node scripts/url-guard.mjs && node scripts/canonical-noindex-sync.mjs && node scripts/sitemap-noindex-prune.mjs && node scripts/empty-render-check.mjs

comment_supply_chain: Build integrity: the Cloudflare build command is `npm ci` (NOT `npm install`), so every deploy installs the exact tree in package-lock.json rather than floating ^ ranges to whatever published since the last build. A poisoned patch release cannot enter a build without a lockfile change in a reviewed commit. The prebuild audit-check.mjs HARD-FAILS on a missing or drifted lockfile, and LOGS npm audit findings without failing: a hard audit gate would let an npm registry outage take deploys down, which trades a supply-chain risk for an availability risk. Keep the lockfile committed and let Dependabot open the version-bump PRs.
comment_astro_4: Astro is pinned at 4.x while the project is on 7.x, so GitHub counts every advisory published since v4 against this repo: 26 as of 2026-09-15, one critical and eight high. All three high-severity ones were checked on that date and are structurally inapplicable here. The critical (GHSA-26w7-cxv4-gfx2, RCE via malicious AVIF) needs Astro to process an untrusted image; every image in this site is a committed brand asset and nothing user-supplied reaches the image pipeline. The SSRF (GHSA-2pvr-wf23-7pc7) needs SSR; this site is fully static. The XSS (GHSA-8hv8-536x-4wqp) needs a client:* directive with a dynamic slot name; grep confirms this site ships no client:* directives at all. Upgrading 4 to 7 is three majors against custom build integrations (capParagraphsInHtml, neutraliseDeadLinks, sitemapKeeps, empty-render-check) and is a deliberate piece of work, not an emergency. Re-check that reasoning before dismissing a NEW advisory: it holds because of what this site does not do, and it stops holding the day it starts doing any of them.
